title: Practice 12: Time in a complex sentence

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: What time does the shuttle bus leave for the airport?
exercises.ru: ___ идёт экспресс до аэропорта?
exercises.why: «Future tense after "когда" and "как только" … » and «the complex conjunctions: до того как, после того как, перед тем как». — DLI, Lessons 37, 92. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: After the calves are weaned they are moved to the plush river-flats for fattening.
exercises.ru: После ___, как телят отлучают от матери, их переселяют на роскошные фермы, чтобы откармливать на убой.
exercises.why: «When a preposition refers to a whole clause, a complex conjunction is used consisting of: 1) the preposition, 2) the pronoun "то" in the case required by the preposition, 3) a linking word»: до того как, перед тем как, о том что, за то что, вместо того чтобы. — DLI, Lesson 92. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Which fits? *Николай Лесков, «На ножах»*
exercises.ru: Потому что вам этого не нужно знать, ___ это сделается.
exercises.why: «Пока is used as an adverb of time and as a conjunction. Пока не (until) is a conjunction … ПОКА НЕ has no negative meaning and the particle НЕ is not translated.» — DLI, Lesson 105. From Николай Лесков, «На ножах».
